items.quote: The therapist made me feel safe. Showing vulnerability is really hard, but she made it so easy.
items.author: RG

items.quote: I was doubtful about therapy, but the way she addresses my concerns from my POV is what I like the most. Her patience while explaining things, and the way she provides a comfortable, non-judgemental space for me to open up without being overbearing or condescending, is something I feel most comfortable with.
items.author: SR

items.quote: The therapist's communication was spot on. She made it comfortable to talk and I felt she understood the situation.
items.author: MK

items.quote: Therapy gave me a safe space to talk about things I was keeping inside for so long. It was great to share with someone who understands.
items.author: PS
